front: Watermark-based incremental copy cannot detect ...
back: Rows deleted in the source; use CDC to capture deletes. Watermark chỉ bắt insert và update.

front: Copy job watermark column types
back: ROWVERSION, datetime, date, integer, and string interpreted as datetime. Cột khác thì cast trong Query của Copy job.

front: Copy job: rows with NULL in the watermark column
back: Excluded from subsequent incremental loads. NULL không so sánh được nên bị bỏ qua.

front: Reset incremental copy + Append write method
back: Can create duplicates; Reset clears the watermark but does not truncate the destination. Dùng Merge hoặc truncate trước full load.

front: Copy job update methods
back: Append (default), Merge, Overwrite, SCD Type 2. Merge mặc định dùng primary key nếu có.

front: Keep history with validity dates, no code, CDC source
back: Copy job CDC with the SCD Type 2 write method (Preview). Copy job tự thêm Valid_From, Valid_To, Is_Current.

front: SCD Type 1 vs Type 2
back: Type 1 overwrites the attribute; Type 2 expires the current row and inserts a new version. Type 2 cần surrogate key và cột validity.

ref.label: Load tables in a dimensional model

front: Fact arrives before its dimension member
back: Insert an inferred member with the natural key and IsInferredMember = TRUE. Khi chi tiết đến thì update, không tạo version SCD.

ref.label: Load tables in a dimensional model

front: Load order for a star schema
back: Stage, dimensions (by dependency), facts, then refresh the semantic model. Dimension trước để fact lookup được surrogate key.

ref.label: Load tables in a dimensional model

front: Truncate and reload a dimension with IDENTITY surrogate keys?
back: Never; keys regenerate and break facts and SCD Type 2 history. Dùng incremental update và soft delete.

front: PySpark team, files, data science
back: Lakehouse. Spark ghi Delta; user T-SQL đọc qua SQL analytics endpoint.

front: T-SQL DML, multi-table transactions, star schema
back: Warehouse. SQL analytics endpoint của lakehouse không cho INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

front: Telemetry, logs, time series, KQL
back: Eventhouse (KQL database). OneLake availability của eventhouse là opt-in.

front: No-code transforms, Power Query, 150+ connectors
back: Dataflow Gen2. Có incremental refresh theo cột DateTime.

ref.label: Decision guide: copy activity, dataflow, Spark

front: Dataflow Gen2 incremental refresh destinations
back: Fabric Lakehouse, Fabric Warehouse, Azure SQL Database. Phải đặt destination rõ ràng, không dùng default destination.

front: Where can you create OneLake shortcuts?
back: In lakehouses (Tables top level or anywhere in Files) and KQL databases. Warehouse không chứa shortcut.

front: Shortcut caching supports ...
back: Google Cloud Storage, S3, S3 compatible, and on-premises gateway shortcuts; retention 1 to 28 days. Giảm egress cost khi đọc lặp.

front: Delete a folder inside a shortcut
back: Deletes the folder in the target if you have write permission there. Chỉ xoá chính shortcut mới giữ nguyên target.

front: Read-only replica of an operational database, MOST cost-effective
back: Mirroring. Compute replicate miễn phí và 1 TB storage mirroring miễn phí cho mỗi CU.

front: Open mirroring landing zone requirements
back: _metadata.json with keyColumns, Parquet or delimited text files, __rowMarker__ as the last column. 0 insert, 1 update, 2 delete, 4 upsert.

front: Highest-throughput T-SQL load from files in ADLS Gen2 or OneLake
back: COPY INTO. Hỗ trợ CSV, JSONL, Parquet.

front: Delta MERGE fails: multiple source rows matched one target row
back: Deduplicate the source per key before MERGE. Delta coi update đó là ambiguous.

ref.label: Delta Lake: table deletes, updates, and merges

front: KQL: keep the latest row per key
back: summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key. Cách dedup chuẩn trong KQL.
